rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala directs people to begin by naming God, seeking blessing through it.
rows.anchor: ابدؤوا أو افتتحوا بتسمية الله تيمنا وتبركا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allah is God's unique proper name, functioning like a proper name among His names, with no known derivation.
rows.anchor: اسم تفرد الباري به سبحانه، يجري في وصفه مجرى أسماء الأعلام، لا يعرف له اشتقاق.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative explanation derives Allah's meaning from being the one worshipped and sought through worship.
rows.anchor: وقيل: معناه: ذو العبادة التي بها يقصد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two divine attributes mean possessing mercy, an abiding divine quality understood as willing good; the names do not differ in meaning, like nadmān and nadīm.
rows.anchor: وهي إرادة الخير، ولا فرق بينهما، مثل: ندمان ونديم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise is laudation of God and thanks to Him for His beneficence.
rows.anchor: هو الثناء لله، والشكر له بإنعامه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lord of the worlds means the owner of all creatures.
rows.anchor: رب العالمين }: مالك المخلوقات كلها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Master of the Day of Judgment means judge of recompense and reckoning, since only God rules on that day.
rows.anchor: قاضي يوم الجزاء والحساب؛ لأنه متفرد في ذلك اليوم بالحكم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship means singling God out and directing oneself to Him in obedience joined with humility.
rows.anchor: نخصك ونقصدك بالعبادة، وهي الطاعة مع الخضوع.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worshippers ask God alone for help.
rows.anchor: إياك نستعين }: ومنك نطلب المعونة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer asks God to show the straight path, lead the worshippers along it, and keep them firm upon it.
rows.anchor: دلنا عليه، واسلك بنا فيه، وثبتنا عليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those granted favor are the followers of Moses and Jesus before they changed God's favor.
rows.anchor: وهم قوم موسى وعيسى عليهما السلام قبل أن يغيروا نعم الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another identification is those described as being with the people God favored in 4:69.
rows.anchor: وقيل: هم الذين ذكرهم الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under divine anger are the Jews; God's anger means His willing punishment.
rows.anchor: وهم اليهود، ومعنى الغضب من الله تعالى: إرادة العقوبة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people who went astray are the Christians; Muslims ask to avoid their deviation from truth as well as the Jews' incurred anger.
rows.anchor: فكأن المسلمين سألوا الله تعالى أن يهديهم طريق الذين أنعم عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception is what God wills to abrogate from the recitation or its retention.
rows.anchor: إلا ما شاء الله } أن ينسخه.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative reads the exception as what God wills, while affirming that He does not will that the Prophet forget.
rows.anchor: وقيل: إلا ما شاء الله، وهو لا يشاء أن تنسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows what is spoken and done openly, and what is concealed.
rows.anchor: إنه يعلم الجهر } من القول والفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes the easy religion of the tolerant, upright monotheistic way easy for the Prophet.
rows.anchor: أي: نهون عليك الشريعة اليسرى، وهي الحنيفية السمحة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is to admonish with the Qur'an, with the reminder understood as admonition if it benefits.
rows.anchor: فعظ بالقرآن { إن نفعت الذكرى } التذكير.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person who fears God will take admonition.
rows.anchor: سيذكر } سيتعظ { من يخشى } الله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The most wretched, as known to God, avoids and distances himself from the reminder.
rows.anchor: ويتجنب الذكرى ويتباعد عنها { الأشقى } في علم الله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wretched person enters Hell.
rows.anchor: الذي يصلى النار الكبرى } الذي يدخل جهنم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the Fire he neither dies to gain relief from torment nor lives a life with vitality.
rows.anchor: لا يموت فيها موتا يستريح به من العذاب، ولا يحيا حياة يجد فيها روح الحياة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful person attains lasting residence in Paradise by doing more righteous deeds.
rows.anchor: قد أفلح } صادف البقاء في الجنة { من تزكى } أكثر من العمل الصالح.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering the Lord's name and praying refers to the five daily prayers.
rows.anchor: وذكر اسم ربه فصلى } أي: الصلوات الخمس.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People choose and prefer the life of this world.
rows.anchor: بل تؤثرون } تختارون { الحياة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The afterlife is better than worldly life and more enduring.
rows.anchor: والآخرة خير وأبقى } من الدنيا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preceding teaching about the purified person's success and the afterlife's superiority is present in earlier scriptures.
rows.anchor: الذي ذكرت من فلاح المتزكي، وكون الآخرة خيرا من الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier scriptures meant here are the books revealed to Abraham and Moses.
rows.anchor: يعني: ما أنزل الله عليهما من الكتب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Overwhelming Event is the Resurrection because it envelops creation; the question signals that this was unknown to the Prophet and his people.
rows.anchor: يعني: القيامة؛ لأنها تغشى الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faces are humbled and abased.
rows.anchor: وجوه يومئذ خاشعة } ذليلة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faces labor in Hell, bearing its heat and punishment, and are fatigued.
rows.anchor: في النار تعالج حرها وعذابها { ناصبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They endure the heat of a blazing, hot fire.
rows.anchor: تصلى نارا } تقاسي حرها { حامية } حارة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are given water from a spring whose heat is extreme.
rows.anchor: تسقى من عين آنية } متناهية في الحرارة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their only food is dried shibriq, a thorny plant that animals neither approach nor graze.
rows.anchor: وهو يبيس الشبرق، وهو نوع من الشوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The food neither makes them fat nor relieves their hunger.
rows.anchor: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The other faces are beautiful and radiant.
rows.anchor: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة } حسنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are pleased with their worldly effort when they receive Paradise because of their deeds.
rows.anchor: لسعيها } في الدنيا { راضية } حين أعطيت الجنة بعملها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their dwelling is a high garden.
rows.anchor: في جنة عالية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No idle or false speech is heard in the garden.
rows.anchor: لا تسمع فيها لاغية } لغوا ولا باطلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cushions are arranged side by side.
rows.anchor: ونمارق مصفوفة } أي: وسائد بعضها بجنب بعض.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rugs and carpets are spread out through the sitting places.
rows.anchor: وهي البسط والطنافس { مبثوثة } مفرقة في المجالس، ثم نبههم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The camel is an immense created sign made tractable for a small creature, directing people to God's oneness.
rows.anchor: ثم نبههم على عظيم من خلقه قد ذلله لصغير؛

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth was spread out flat.
rows.anchor: سطحت } أي: بسطت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger is to remind people of God's blessings and proofs of His oneness; this is his mission.
rows.anchor: ذكرهم نعم الله ودلائل توحيده، فإنك مبعوث بذلك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is not empowered to compel people into faith; this was before he was commanded to fight.
rows.anchor: بمسلط تكرههم على الإيمان، وهذا قبل أن أمر بالحرب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception concerns whoever turns away from faith and disbelieves.
rows.anchor: لكن من تولى عن الإيمان { وكفر }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will punish such a person with the greatest punishment, the punishment of Hell.
rows.anchor: فيعذبه الله العذاب الأكبر } عذاب جهنم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their return is to God.
rows.anchor: إن إلينا إيابهم } رجوعهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God undertakes their reckoning.
rows.anchor: ثم إن علينا حسابهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iram refers to the first Aad, genealogically Aad son of Aws son of Iram; Iram is the tribe's name.
rows.anchor: يعني: عادا الأولى، وهو عاد بن عوص بن إرم، وإرم: اسم القبيلة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Aad were tall.
rows.anchor: ذات العماد } أي: ذات الطول،

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One alternative takes the pillars as lofty buildings.
rows.anchor: وقيل: ذات البناء الرفيع،

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view understands mobile tent poles: Aad were nomads who traveled seeking rainfall.
rows.anchor: وقيل: ذات العمد السيارة، وذلك أنهم كانوا أهل عمد سيارة ينتجعون الغيث.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No people like Aad had been created in the lands in might, strength, and height.
rows.anchor: في بطشهم وقوتهم وطول قامتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thamud cut rock into houses in the valley, identified as Wadi al-Qura, where they lived.
rows.anchor: قطعوا { الصخر } فاتخذوا منها البيوت { بالواد } يعني: وادي القرى، وكانت مساكنهم هناك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Pharaoh had numerous troops and hosts, and many tents they pegged up while traveling.
rows.anchor: ذي الجنود والجموع الكثيرة، وكانت لهم مضارب كثيرة يوتدونها في أسفارهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whip of punishment is a metaphor: God made the punishment with which He struck them His whip.
rows.anchor: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب } أي: جعل سوطه الذي ضربهم به العذاب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This answers the oath at the surah's beginning; God watches, hears, and observes human deeds.
rows.anchor: جواب القسم الذي في أول السورة { لبالمرصاد } بحيث يرى ويسمع ويرصد أعمال بني آدم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human here means the disbeliever, whose trial is prosperity and abundance; he treats wealth as proof that God honored him.
rows.anchor: يعني: الكافر { إذا ما ابتلاه ربه } امتحنه بالنعمة والسعة { فأكرمه } بالمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbeliever fails to recognize divine honor except as a large share of worldly goods.
rows.anchor: لا يرى الكرامة من الله إلا بكثرة الحظ من الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the disbeliever's provision is restricted, he regards his small worldly share as humiliation from God.
rows.anchor: فضيق { عليه رزقه فيقول ربي أهانن } يرى الهوان في قلة حظه من الدنيا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For a believer, honor is God's honoring him through obedience, while humiliation is His debasing him through disobedience.
rows.anchor: فأما المؤمن فالكرامة عنده أن يكرمه الله بطاعته، والهوان أن يهينه بمعصيته،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The correction rejects the disbeliever's assumption; the people abandoned the orphan's inheritance and denied what was due to him.
rows.anchor: من ترك توريث اليتيم، وحرمانه ما يستحق من الميراث.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Binding means captivity, chains, and fetters; no creature can punish and bind as completely as God.
rows.anchor: يعني بالوثاق الإسار والسلاسل والأغلال، والمعنى: لا يبلغ أحد من الخلق كبلاغ الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tranquil soul is confident in what God promised and believes it.
rows.anchor: إلى ما وعد الله سبحانه المصدقة بذاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to return is addressed to the soul at death; she is content with God's gift and approved by her Lord.
rows.anchor: يقال لها ذلك عند الموت. { راضية } بما آتاها الله { مرضية } رضي عنها ربها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This address takes place as the soul leaves the world; the next invitation occurs on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: هذا عند خروجها من الدنيا، فإذا كان يوم القيامة قيل:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She is invited to join the company of God's righteous servants.
rows.anchor: فادخلي في عبادي } أي: في جملة عبادي الصالحين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She is invited to enter God's Paradise.
rows.anchor: وادخلي جنتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who succeeds is made happy, as God reforms his soul and purifies it from sins.
rows.anchor: سعد { من زكاها } أصلح الله نفسه وطهرها من الذنوب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The failed soul is made low and vile until it commits wickedness; the verb also suggests concealing, lowering, burdening, and abandoning it.
rows.anchor: جعلها الله ذليلة خسيسة حتى عملت بالفجور، ومعنى دساها: أخفى محلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thamud denied the messengers through their transgression.
rows.anchor: كذبت ثمود بطغواها } بطغيانها كذبت الرسل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The most wretched one arose; he was the camel's killer.
rows.anchor: إذ انبعث } قام { أشقاها } عاقر الناقة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's messenger is Salih, who told them to leave God's she-camel and let her drink on her allotted day.
rows.anchor: فقال لهم رسول الله } [صالح]. { ناقة الله } ذروا ناقة الله { وسقياها } وشربها في يومها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They denied Salih and killed the camel; God utterly destroyed them for their sin and leveled the punishment over them all.
rows.anchor: فكذبوه فعقروها } فقتلوا الناقة { فدمدم عليهم ربهم } أهلكهم هلاك استئصال { بذنبهم فسواها }

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation says God leveled Thamud through destruction, afflicting young and old alike.
rows.anchor: وقيل: سوى ثمود بالهلاك، فأنزله بصغيرها وكبيرها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fears no one else's consequence for the punishment He sent upon them.
rows.anchor: عقباها } لا يخاف الله من أحد تبعة ما أنزل بهم.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Alternatively, the most wretched man did not fear the consequence of his crime.
rows.anchor: وقيل: لا يخاف أشقاها عاقبة جنايته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking the face of the Most High means seeking God's reward.
rows.anchor: أي: لكن طلب ثواب الله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He will be content by entering Paradise.
rows.anchor: ولسوف يرضى } سيدخل الجنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Muhammad's parents died, they left him neither wealth nor shelter; God sheltered him with his uncle Abu Talib, who raised him.
rows.anchor: حين مات أبواك ولم يخلفا لك مالا ولا مأوى { فآوى } فآواك إلى عمك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being astray means not yet knowing the prophetic signs, Qur'anic rulings, or religious law; God guided him to them.
rows.anchor: عما أنت عليه اليوم من معالم النبوة وأحكام القرآن والشريعة، فهداك إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He links the explanation to the verse saying Muhammad did not know the Book or faith beforehand.
rows.anchor: كقوله: ما كنت تدري ما الكتاب ولا الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God enriched Muhammad, who had been poor and without property, through Khadija's wealth and later through spoils.
rows.anchor: فقيرا ولا مال لك، فأغناك بمال خديجة رضي الله عنه، ثم بالغنائم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not oppress the orphan in his property, and remember your own orphanhood.
rows.anchor: فأما اليتيم فلا تقهر } على ماله، واذكر يتمك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not rebuke the asker: offer something small or answer kindly, remembering your former poverty.
rows.anchor: فلا تزجره، ولكن بذل يسير، أو رد جميل، واذكر فقرك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessing to be proclaimed is prophethood and the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: وأما بنعمة ربك } أي: النبوة والقرآن { فحدث } أخبر بها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After finishing prayer, exert yourself in supplication, ask God for what you need, and turn to Him earnestly.
rows.anchor: فإذا فرغت } من صلاتك { فانصب } أي: اتعب في الدعاء وسله حاجتك، وارغب إلى الله تعالى به.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After this proof, what could make a human deny the reckoning and recompense?
rows.anchor: أيها الإنسان { بعد } هذه الحجة { بالدين } بالحساب والجزاء،

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Alternatively, the address is to Muhammad: after the proof of God's power to create humanity, who could deny the promised reward and punishment?
rows.anchor: وقيل: إن هذا خطاب للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، فما الذي يكذبك يا محمد بعد ما تبين من قدرتنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the wisest judge in all He creates and does, all of which indicates His knowledge and wisdom.
rows.anchor: في جميع ما خلق وصنع، وكل ذلك دال على علمه وحكمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Read the Qur'an in the name of God, meaning pronounce the basmala at the beginning of every sura.
rows.anchor: يعني: اقرأ القرآن باسم ربك، وهو أن تذكر التسمية في ابتداء كل سورة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Creator made all things and creatures.
rows.anchor: الذي خلق } الأشياء والمخلوقات.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human being means Adam's descendant, created from clinging-clots; alaq is the plural of alaqa.
rows.anchor: خلق الإنسان } يعني: ابن آدم { من علق } جمع علقة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's generosity here is His forbearance toward servants' ignorance, without hastening punishment.
rows.anchor: يعني: الحليم عن جهل العباد، فلا يعجل عليهم بالعقوبة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Teaching by the pen is teaching writing.
rows.anchor: الذي علم بالقلم } ثم بين ما علم، فقال:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught humanity what it had not known, namely script and writing.
rows.anchor: علم الإنسان ما لم يعلم } وهو الخط والكتابة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle rebukes emphatically: the human oversteps and grows arrogant toward his Lord.
rows.anchor: كلا } حقا { إن الإنسان ليطغى } ليتجاوز ويستكبر على ربه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human transgresses when he sees himself as self-sufficient.
rows.anchor: أن رآه } رأى نفسه { استغنى }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The return is to God in the afterlife, where He recompenses the tyrant as deserved.
rows.anchor: إن إلى ربك الرجعى } المرجع في الآخرة، فيجازي الطاغي بما يستحقه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person who forbids prayer is Abu Jahl.
rows.anchor: أرأيت الذي ينهى } يعني: أبا جهل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Jahl threatened to trample Muhammad's neck if he saw him praying.
rows.anchor: وذلك أنه قال: لئن رأيت محمدا يصلي لأطأن على رقبته،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here ‘Have you seen?’ expresses astonishment; the linked questions contrast the guided, pious worshipper with a liar who turns away from the reminder.
rows.anchor: ومعنى: أرأيت ها هنا تعجب، وكذلك قوله:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worshipper is on guidance and commands reverence for God.
rows.anchor: أرأيت إن كان على الهدى }. { أو أمر بالتقوى }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forbidding opponent denies the truth and turns away from the reminder, making the contrast astonishing.
rows.anchor: والناهي كاذب متول عن الذكرى، أي: فما أعجب من ذا!

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Jahl should know that God sees him and knows what he does.
rows.anchor: ألم يعلم } أبو جهل { بأن الله يرى } أي: يراه ويعلم ما يفعله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle is a rebuke and threat; if Abu Jahl persists in disbelief and hostility to the Prophet, he will be seized by the forelock and dragged to Hell.
rows.anchor: كلا } ردع وزجر { لئن لم ينته } عما هو عليه من الكفر ومعاداة النبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the forelock lying and sinful describes its owner as a liar and sinner.
rows.anchor: ناصية كاذبة خاطئة } وتأويلها: صاحبها كاذب خاطىء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command challenges Abu Jahl to summon his assembly and seek their help; he had threatened the Messenger with a valley full of horses and men.
rows.anchor: فليدع ناديه } فليستعن بأهل مجلسه، وذلك أنه قال لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: لأملأن عليك هذا الوادي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The zabaniya are stern and mighty angels.
rows.anchor: سندع الزبانية } وهم الملائكة الغلاظ الشداد.

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet warned that if Abu Jahl called his assembly, the zabaniya would seize him in plain sight.
rows.anchor: لو دعا ناديه لأخذته الزبانية عيانا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Jahl's expectation is false; the Prophet must not obey him, but pray and draw near to God through obedience.
rows.anchor: كلا } ليس الأمر على ما عليه أبو جهل { لا تطعه واسجد } وصل { واقترب } تقرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Night of Decree is the night of judgment, when God determines the year's affairs; qadr denotes determination.
rows.anchor: ليلة الحكم والفصل، يقضي الله فيها قضاء السنة، والقدر: بمعنى التقدير.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whole Qur'an descended from the Preserved Tablet to the lowest heaven on that night, then Gabriel delivered it to the Prophet over twenty years.
rows.anchor: أنزل الله تعالى القرآن كله في ليلة القدر جملة واحدة من اللوح المحفوظ إلى سماء الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question to Muhammad magnifies and marvels at the Night of Decree's significance.
rows.anchor: وما أدراك } يا محمد عليه السلام { ما ليلة القدر } على التعظيم لشأنها والتعجيب منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night is better than a thousand months that contain no Night of Decree.
rows.anchor: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر } أي: من ألف شهر ليس فيها ليلة القدر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Spirit is Gabriel, who descends with the angels on that night.
rows.anchor: تنزل الملائكة والروح } يعني: جبريل عليه السلام { فيها } في تلك الليلة { بإذن ربهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They descend by God's permission with every affair decreed that night for the year; the statement ends here before the next clause.
rows.anchor: بإذن ربهم من كل أمر } أي: بكل أمر قضاه الله تعالى في تلك الليلة للسنة، وتم الكلام ها هنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whole night is safety and good, without illness, and Satan cannot do anything then.
rows.anchor: سلام هي } أي: تلك الليلة كلها سلامة وخير لا داء فيها،

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation is that the angels greet the people in the mosques that night.
rows.anchor: وقيل: يعني: تسليم الملائكة في تلك الليلة على أهل المساجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night continues until dawn rises.
rows.anchor: حتى مطلع الفجر } إلى وقت طلوع الفجر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelieving People of the Book are Jews and Christians, while the polytheists are the unbelieving Arabs.
rows.anchor: من أهل الكتاب } أي: اليهود والنصارى { والمشركين } يعني: كفار العرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ‘Breaking away’ means ceasing and departing from disbelief; the clear proof is Muhammad and the Qur'an, who came to them.
rows.anchor: منتهين زائلين عن كفرهم { حتى تأتيهم البينة } يعني: أتتهم البينة، أي: البيان والبصيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They did not leave unbelief until Muhammad was sent; this refers to those from both groups who believed.
rows.anchor: يقول: لم يتركوا كفرهم حتى بعث إليهم محمد عليه السلام، وهذا فيمن آمن من الفريقين،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The messenger recites scriptures purified of falsehood.
rows.anchor: كتبا { مطهرة } من الباطل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The books contain rulings that are upright and just.
rows.anchor: فيها كتب } أحكام { قيمة } مستقيمة عادلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The People of the Book knew Muhammad was true from his scriptural description; after the proof identified him as the promised prophet in Torah and Gospel, they divided, some rejecting from envy and others believing.
rows.anchor: ما اختلفوا في كون محمد عليه السلام حقا لما يجدون من نعته في كتابهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They had agreed on his prophethood's truth, then some denied him when he was sent; this is like the verse about disagreement after knowledge from envy.
rows.anchor: يريد: أنهم كانوا مجتمعين على صحة نبوته، فلما بعث جحدوا نبوته وتفرقوا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The People of the Book were commanded to worship God alone, sincerely obeying Him and associating no partner with Him.
rows.anchor: مخلصين له الدين } الطاعة، أي: موحدين له لا يعبدون معه غيره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being upright in faith means following the religion of Abraham and Muhammad.
rows.anchor: حنفاء } على دين إبراهيم عليه السلام ودين محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The upright religion is the straight community's religion.
rows.anchor: أي: دين الملة القيمة، وهي المستقيمة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the Hour the earth will be shaken with a violent shaking.
rows.anchor: زلزالها } أي: حركت حركة شديدة لقيام الساعة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth casts out its treasures and dead, throwing them onto its surface.
rows.anchor: وأخرجت الأرض أثقالها } كنوزها وموتاها، فألقتها على ظهرها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The questioning human is an unbeliever in resurrection, objecting to the upheaval.
rows.anchor: وقال الإنسان } يعني: الكافر الذي لا يؤمن بالبعث { ما لها } إنكارا لتلك الحالة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth will report the good and evil deeds performed upon it.
rows.anchor: يومئذ تحدث أخبارها } أي: تخبر بما عمل عليها من خير وشر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God inspired the earth by commanding and permitting it to speak.
rows.anchor: بأن ربك أوحى لها } أي: أمرها بالكلام وأذن لها فيه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People leave the gathering for reckoning in separated groups, some going right and others left, to see their deeds' recompense.
rows.anchor: يومئذ يصدر الناس } ينصرف الناس { أشتاتا } متفرقين عن موقف الحساب، فآخذ ذات اليمين، وآخذ ذات الشمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A believer sees the reward of an atom's weight of good in the afterlife; an unbeliever sees it in himself, family, and property in this world.
rows.anchor: يرى المؤمن ثوابه في الآخرة، والكافر في الدنيا يراه في نفسه وأهله وماله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A believer's recompense for an atom's weight of evil comes as worldly griefs and calamities, while an unbeliever receives it in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: جزاء المؤمن في الدنيا بالأحزان والمصائب، والكافر في الآخرة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The contents of the graves are scattered when the dead are resurrected.
rows.anchor: إذا بعثر } قلب فأثير { ما في القبور } يعني: إذا بعث الموتى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is in hearts is brought out and made clear, including disbelief and faith.
rows.anchor: وحصل } بين وأبرز { ما في الصدور } [من الكفر والإيمان.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows people and will recompense them for disbelief; ‘them’ is used because ‘human’ denotes a collective genus.
rows.anchor: عالم فيجازيهم على كفرهم في ذلك اليوم، وإنما قال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessings questioned about are security and health, and how people spent their lives with them.
rows.anchor: ثم لتسألن يومئذ عن النعيم } عن الأمن والصحة فيما أفنيتموها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire's pain and burning reach into the hearts.
rows.anchor: التي تطلع على الأفئدة } أي: يبلغ ألمها وإحراقها إلى الأفئدة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is closed over them.
rows.anchor: إنها عليهم مؤصدة } مطبقة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ‘Amad’ is the plural of column, and the columns are extended.
rows.anchor: في عمد } جمع عمود. { ممددة }.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view identifies the columns as stakes of the covers that close over the people.
rows.anchor: قيل: يعني: أوتاد الأطباق التي تطبق عليهم، ومعنى { في عمد }: بعمد.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view says they are columns used to torture them in the Fire.
rows.anchor: وقيل: إنها عمد يعذبون بها في النار.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ‘Did you not see?’ means ‘Did you not know?’
rows.anchor: ألم تر } ألم تعلم. وقيل: ألم تخبر

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another gloss is ‘Were you not informed?’
rows.anchor: وقيل: ألم تخبر { كيف فعل ربك بأصحاب الفيل }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God frustrated the elephant army's plot to destroy the Kaaba.
rows.anchor: ألم يجعل كيدهم في تضليل } أضل كيدهم عما أرادوا من تخريب الكعبة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ababil means flock after flock, in groups.
rows.anchor: وأرسل عليهم طيرا أبابيل } جماعات جماعات.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sijjil stones were bricks.
rows.anchor: ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل } من آجر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They became like crops trampled and broken after animals ate them; ‘asf’ means crop foliage.
rows.anchor: كزرع أكلته الدواب فداسته وفتتته. والعصف: ورق الزرع.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reading connects the opening lām to the preceding sura: God destroyed the elephant army so Quraysh could survive and grow accustomed to its journeys.
rows.anchor: قيل: هذه اللام تتصل بما قبلها، على معنى: أهلك الله أصحاب الفيل لتبقى قريش وتألف رحلتيها.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another takes the lām as delayed in word order: Quraysh should worship the Lord of the House in gratitude for their familiar journeys and other blessings.
rows.anchor: وقيل: معنى اللام التأخير، على معنى: فليعبدوا رب هذا البيت { لإيلاف قريش }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word ilaaf is synonymous with alif; Quraysh had winter and summer journeys to Yemen and Syria that sustained their trade and livelihood.
rows.anchor: يقال: ألف الشيء وآلفه بمعنى واحد، والمعنى: لإلف قريش رحلتيها، وذلك انه كانت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one attacked Quraysh during these journeys; their status as sanctuary residents and guardians of the House was God's favor.
rows.anchor: كانت تقوم معايشهم وتجاراتهم. وكان لا يتعرض لهم في تجارتهم أحد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should worship the Lord of the House.
rows.anchor: وقال: { فليعبدوا رب هذا البيت }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fed Quraysh after famine so severe they ate carrion and corpses, then relieved them.
rows.anchor: الذي أطعمهم من جوع } أي: بعد جوع، وكانوا قد أصابتهم شدة حتى أكلوا الميتة والجيف،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made them secure from raids in the sanctuary and from danger on their journeys.
rows.anchor: وآمنهم من خوف } فلا يخافون في الحرم الغارة، ولا يخافون في رحلتهم.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Al-Kawthar is a river in Paradise whose banks are pearls.
rows.anchor: إنا أعطيناك الكوثر } قيل: هو نهر في الجنة حافتاه الدر.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view interprets al-Kawthar as abundant good.
rows.anchor: وقيل: هو الخير الكثير.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The command to pray refers to the Eid prayer on the day of sacrifice, and to sacrifice the ritual animal.
rows.anchor: فصل لربك } صلاة العيد، يعني: يوم النحر { وانحر } نسكك.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view understands ‘pray’ as placing the hands at the neck during prayer.
rows.anchor: وقيل: { فصل } فضع يدك على نحرك في صلاتك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's hater is cut off from descendants.
rows.anchor: إن شانئك } مبغضك { هو الأبتر } المنقطع العقب.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another gloss says the hater is cut off from every good; it was revealed about al-As ibn Wa'il, who called the Prophet abtar when his son al-Qasim died.
rows.anchor: [وقيل: المنقطع عن كل خير. نزلت في العاص بن وائل سمى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أبتر عند موت ابنه القاسم]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sura was revealed about a group of Quraysh who proposed that they worship the Prophet's God for a year if he worshipped their idols for a year.
rows.anchor: نزلت في رهط من قريش قالوا للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم تعبد آلهتنا سنة. ونعبد إلهك سنة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's refusal applies to present worship: he does not worship their idols now.
rows.anchor: لا أعبد ما تعبدون } في الحال.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not worship what he worships in the present.
rows.anchor: ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد } في الحال ما أعبده.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet will never worship the idols they worshipped; the future-tense wording applies to the future.
rows.anchor: ولا أنا عابد } في الاستقبال { ما عبدتم }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will not worship his God in the future either; God told him this group would never believe, and the repeated refusal ends their hope of his idol worship.
rows.anchor: فنفي عنهم عبادة الله في الحال، وفيما يستقبل، وهذا في قوم أعلمه الله أنهم لا يؤمنون،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their religion is polytheism and his is Islam; this statement preceded the command to fight.
rows.anchor: لكم دينكم } الشرك { ولي دين } الإسلام، وهذا قبل أن يؤمر بالحرب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's help is against those opposing the Prophet among Jews and Arabs; the victory is the conquest of Mecca.
rows.anchor: إذا جاء نصر الله } إياك على من ناوأك من اليهود والعرب { والفتح } يعني: فتح مكة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People entered God's religion in groups after previously entering one by one.
rows.anchor: ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجا } جماعات جماعات بعد ما كان يدخل واحد فواحد.

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: When the sura was revealed, the Prophet said that his own death had been announced to him.
rows.anchor: وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لما نزلت هذه السورة قال: قد نعيت إلي نفسي.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God commanded abundant glorification and seeking forgiveness, so the Prophet would end his life by increasing righteous deeds.
rows.anchor: فسبح بحمد ربك } أمره الله عز وجل أن يكثر التسبيح والاستغفار، ليختم له في آخر عمره بالزيادة في العمل الصالح.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the command to warn his near relatives, the Prophet called Quraysh from Safa, gathered them, warned of the Fire, and Abu Lahab cursed him for summoning them; this occasion led to the sura's revelation.
rows.anchor: لما نزل قوله: { وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين } صعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الصفا، ونادى بأعلى صوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening means Abu Lahab's hands failed and lost, and he himself failed and lost.
rows.anchor: تبت يدا أبي لهب } أي: خابت وخسرت { وتب } وخسر هو،

rows.speaker: أبو لهب
rows.claim: Abu Lahab claimed that if his nephew's warning were true, he would ransom himself from the punishment with his wealth and children.
rows.anchor: ولما خوفه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالعذاب قال: إنه إن كان ما يقوله ابن أخي حقا؛ فإني أفتدي منه بمالي وولدي،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His wealth and what he gained refers to his child, and could not benefit him.
rows.anchor: ما أغنى عنه ماله وما كسب } يعني: ولده.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Lahab will enter a fire with flames.
rows.anchor: سيصلى نارا ذات لهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His wife, Umm Jamil, sister of Abu Sufyan, carried tales and walked about spreading slander.
rows.anchor: وامرأته حمالة الحطب } نقالة الحديث الماشية بالنميمة، وهي أم جميل أخت أبي سفيان.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rope around her neck is an iron chain seventy cubits long, entering her mouth, passing out her rear, and winding around her neck.
rows.anchor: في عنقها { حبل من مسد } سلسلة من حديد ذرعها سبعون ذراعا، تدخل في فيها وتخرج من دبرها،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Masad is anything used to twist and secure a rope.
rows.anchor: والمسد: كل ما أحكم به الحبل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some polytheists asked the Messenger to describe God's lineage, and the sura was revealed in response.
rows.anchor: روي أن قوما من المشركين قال لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: انسب لنا ربك، فأنزل الله عز وجل:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one whose lineage they asked about is the one God, Allah.
rows.anchor: قل هو الله أحد } أي: الذي سألتم نسبته هو الله أحد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Samad is the master whose sovereignty reaches its utmost limit.
rows.anchor: الله الصمد } السيد الذي قد انتهى إليه السؤدد.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported meaning of al-Samad is that God has no hollow and neither eats nor drinks.
rows.anchor: وقيل: الصمد: الذي لا جوف له، ولا يأكل ولا يشرب.

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another reported meaning is the one to whom people turn with their needs.
rows.anchor: وقيل: هو المقصود إليه في الرغائب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God neither begets nor was begotten.
rows.anchor: لم يلد ولم يولد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one is God's equal or likeness.
rows.anchor: ولم يكن له كفوا أحد } لم يكن أحد مثلا له.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This sura and the next were revealed after the Jewish Labid ibn al-A'sam bewitched the Prophet, causing severe illness; God disclosed the spell's location, and people retrieved an eleven-knotted cord. Undoing each knot brought relief until all were undone; God ordered him to seek refuge with the two suras, whose eleven verses match the knots.
rows.anchor: نزلت هذه السورة والتي بعدها لما سحر لبيد بن الأعصم اليهودي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، فاشتكى شكوى شديدة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-falaq means dawn.
rows.anchor: برب الفلق } يعني: الصبح.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ghasiq is night, and its waqaba means that it enters.
rows.anchor: ومن شر غاسق } يعني: الليل { إذا وقب } دخل.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ‘blowers into knots’ are sorceresses blowing into the knots with something they recite.
rows.anchor: ومن شر النفاثات } يعني: السواحر تنفث { في العقد } كأنها تنفخ فيها بشيء تقرؤه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The envier singled out is Labid, who bewitched the Prophet.
rows.anchor: ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد } يعني: لبيدا الذي سحره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whisperer is the possessor of whispering, namely Satan; the retreating one withdraws when God is remembered.
rows.anchor: من شر الوسواس } [يعني: ذا الوسواس] وهو الشيطان { الخناس } وهو الذي يخنس ويرجع إذا ذكر الله،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan crouches on the human heart and withdraws at God's remembrance; when a person is heedless, Satan seizes the heart, speaks to it, and makes promises.
rows.anchor: والشيطان جاثم على قلب الإنسان، فإذا ذكر الله تنحى وخنس، وإذا غفل التقم قلبه فحدثه ومناه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The whispering occurs in people's breasts.
rows.anchor: الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The jinn are Satan's kind, from among the jinn.
rows.anchor: من الجنة } أي: الشيطان الذي هو من الجن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ‘People’ coordinates with ‘the whisperer’; the command seeks refuge from the evil of whispering jinn and from the evil of human beings.
rows.anchor: والناس } عطف على قوله: الوسواس. والمعنى: من شر ذي الوسواس ومن شر الناس،
